user.title: Connect to a Smart HV controller
user.description: Connect over the trusted LAN. Setup only reads; writes are disabled until explicitly selected in options. Supported calls were curated to avoid initiating the boiler's SERVICE mode.

data_description.host: Bare hostname or IP address, without http:// or a path.

reconfigure.title: Change connection address
reconfigure.description: The new address must identify the same physical controller. No settings are written.

error.cannot_connect: The controller could not be reached. Check the trusted LAN connection and port.
error.auth_failed: The controller connection could not be authenticated. Check connectivity and controller compatibility.
error.cooldown: The controller's authentication cooldown is active. Wait before trying again.
error.incompatible: The controller returned an unsupported response.
error.invalid_host: Enter a bare hostname or IP address and a valid port.
error.no_unique_id: No usable controller MAC, system ID, or serial number was returned. An IP address cannot be used as device identity.

abort.already_in_progress: A setup flow for this controller is already running.
abort.wrong_device: The address identifies a different controller. The existing device was not reassigned.

init.title: Controls and diagnostics
init.description: Writes can affect heating immediately. The SDK's actual writes and physical effects are not live-validated. Select only intended controls; no setting is changed while saving options. Programs replace all windows, and daily/weekly selection is never switched automatically.

data.acknowledge_writes: I understand the operational risk of enabling selected writes
data.pcb_diagnostics: Read optional PCB diagnostics (raw, disabled by default)

data_description.raw_channels: Reviewed operating readings are already normal sensors. This adds unclassified internal channels as disabled diagnostic entities.

error.acknowledge_writes: Acknowledge the risk before enabling any writes.
error.invalid_controls: Select only the reviewed settings offered in this form.

read_failed.message: The controller read failed. Read-only polling will retry automatically.

identity_changed.message: The controller identity could not be verified. Check the configured host before retrying.

writes_disabled.message: This setting is not explicitly enabled for writing, or the integration is unloading.

state_unavailable.message: A current parameter snapshot is unavailable. Wait for a successful refresh.

change_refused.message: The change was refused because the value, expected state, device identity, or circuit configuration did not pass validation.

write_mismatch.message: The stored value did not match the requested change. Inspect the controller; no write was replayed or rolled back.

write_unknown.message: The write outcome is uncertain. Inspect current state before another intentional change; no write was replayed or rolled back.

expected_required.message: Applying a program requires the complete expected current program.

invalid_program.message: The program is invalid. Check day coverage, group/window limits, and local start/end times.

set_circuit_program.name: Set circuit program
set_circuit_program.description: Preview or replace one opted-in circuit's complete comfort program. Does not change circuit mode or global daily/weekly selection. Applying requires the expected current program.

circuit.name: Circuit
circuit.description: Controller circuit designation, not a physical room name.

kind.name: Program type
kind.description: Must already be selected globally at the controller.

program.name: Replacement program
program.description: Daily programs use a time_ranges list. Weekly programs use a groups list with numeric weekdays and time_ranges. See the documentation for complete examples.

expected.name: Expected current program
expected.description: Same object shape as the replacement, containing every current window/group. Required when applying.

preview_only.name: Preview only
preview_only.description: Enabled by default. Disable only to intentionally apply the opted-in program.
